function.description: This API fetches the count of profiling rules based on the filter values provided in the query parameters. The filter parameters are same as that of 'GET /profiling-rules' API, excluding the pagination and sort parameters.
function.name: api_getCountOfProfilingRules

includeDeleted.description: Flag to indicate whether deleted rules should be part of the records fetched.

ruleType.description: Use comma-separated list of rule types to filter the data. Defaults to 'Custom Rule'.
